lines.cap: Riya comes home and says, I'm fine. Her mum hears something else. And the ghost in the hallway? He's seen it all.
lines.say: Riya comes home and says, I'm fine. Her mum hears something else. And the ghost in the hallway? He's seen it all.

lines.cap: Riya drops her bag. A little too hard.
lines.say: Riya drops her bag. A little too hard.

lines.cap: Level eight. I've haunted this house since eighteen twenty four.
lines.say: Level eight. I've haunted this house since eighteen twenty four.

lines.cap: So Mum starts cooking. Everything. All of it.
lines.say: So Mum starts cooking. Everything. All of it.

lines.cap: I can't even eat. And I'm jealous.
lines.say: I can't even eat. And I'm jealous.

lines.cap: Riya goes to her room. Door shut.
lines.say: Riya goes to her room. Door shut.

lines.cap: No means yes. Even I know that.
lines.say: No means yes. Even I know that.

lines.cap: At midnight, Riya opens her door. A plate. Still warm. And a note.
lines.say: At midnight, Riya opens her door. A plate. Still warm. And a note.

lines.cap: Best family I've ever haunted. Don't tell them.
lines.say: Best family I've ever haunted. Don't tell them.

lines.cap: Tag the one who always knows. Because when Riya comes home and says, I'm fine.
lines.say: Tag the one who always knows. Because when Riya comes home and says, I'm fine.
